findings.rationale: Grading run-time drawn jobs against the verifier's model is kept (it answers the v2 sealed-corpus finding), but the seed no longer comes from the OS: DRAW_SEEDS = (5, 6, 31, 139), one job each, so every clean run grades the same four jobs. The fixed set is chosen to guarantee the panel's first flip case (a 40-row job: seed 5) and asserts it, plus a 1-row job.

gate.rule: no verifier input may derive from OS entropy, time or unseeded RNG; any run-time draw uses fixed seeds and asserts the boundary cases it must include (blueprint determinism class; candidate for panel_precheck rule: grep tests/ for os.urandom/secrets/uuid4/random.seed() without literal)
